title: Safenet Aegis Rewards Distribution - Period 2
headline: A post reports that Safenet Aegis rewards for the Oct 27 - Nov 10, 2026 period were distributed on Nov 18 after the permissionless Reality.eth approval process.
summary: This is a report on a completed distribution, not a request for a vote. It states that Safenet Aegis rewards for period 2 (October 27 to November 10, 2026, UTC) were distributed on November 18, 2026, following the permissionless Reality.eth approval process defined in SEP-56. The post links the distribution package with Merkle proofs on IPFS, the Reality.eth question, the execution transaction and the distribution contract. Eligible recipients can claim directly from the distributor contract or through third-party interfaces named in the post. Rewards periods are biweekly, and once a period concludes anyone can start the permissionless distribution process described in SEP-56. The post gives no reward amounts and no totals. Open questions: the size of the distribution and the number of recipients are not stated in the post.
